title.jp: 小さなカンニングペーパー

description.en:
Prerequisite: Complete “Talk to Contess” in “Rules Unbound”.
At night. Approach the anxious student and speak to him.
Location: Lyceum Peninsula 1.
description.jp:
前提条件：「謎の校則」の「カーディスと話す」を完了する。
夜に。 焦っている学生に近づいて話しかける。
場所：1-レヒラム半島。
description.kr:
선행 조건: 「신비한 교칙」의 「칸티아스와 대화하기」 완료.
밤에. 초조한 학생에게 다가가 말 걸기.
장소: 1-라이세움 반도.
description.cn:
前置条件：完成《神秘的校规》中的“与康缇丝对话”。
夜晚。 靠近焦急的学生并交谈。
地点：1-莱希拉姆半岛。

extra_rule.scope: configured conditional menu visibility; actor remains subject to this rule

behavior_receiver.reading_policy: One presentation per authored state window; proximity repeats are not duplicated in the transcript.

extra_rule.scope: configured conditional menu visibility; actor remains subject to this rule

behavior_receiver.reading_policy: Speech runs in parallel with departure movement before action-complete/FinishDelay; no exact movement timing is asserted.

menu_receivers.dispatch: selected dynamic menu with action bit → exact MenuWorldActionOption → C_RunPlot

consumer.probe_output:
PASS	NPCInit writes the actual agent GameObject
PASS	NPCInit initializes head/dialogue/animator in order
PASS	NPCInit ends its action after initialization
PASS	untreated NPC uses sick-state action
PASS	remaining attempts keep the treatment window open
PASS	zero disease selects success display after attempts end
PASS	success display does not write authoritative healed-ID membership
PASS	exhausted unsuccessful treatment uses fail-state action
PASS	exhaustion and authoritative healing are distinct predicates
PASS	supplied healed-ID membership independently selects success
PASS	another patient never inherits the supplied healed identity
PASS	unmarked transform state cannot launch a Plot
PASS	marked state still requires the transform unlock condition
PASS	both transform conditions select the exact configured Plot
PASS	missing transform rows return -1, not another NPC’s Plot
CHECKS	15
consumer.initialization: Enable → BindBehaviourTree(101) → NPCInit → npc_action_init → InitBTParam(Task, selected state or CShow_1)
consumer.stationary: BTCase2 → Distance0/empty path/zero speed → BTCase0 → inRange → cooldown → transformed Plot when admitted, otherwise nonzero task Plot
consumer.retirement: npc_action_complete → DitherOut → FinishDelay → RemoveDelayObject; emitted by the leave/movement branch, not every stationary state change
consumer.limits: Native geometry and server population are not simulated. No fixed playback count or retirement duration is inferred.
